{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''The Useful Bureaucrats''''' was a manifesto written by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] as part of his work, ''[[Absolute Power]]''.

The volume detailed how Sidious, under his public persona of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine, managed to manipulate several important figures and events to ensure his rise to power. He also mentioned that his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], had a minor role in these events.
